```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
selected_section <- as.character(params$class_section)
sections <- read_csv("data/sections.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
section_info <- sections |> filter(as.character(section) == selected_section)
stopifnot(nrow(section_info) == 1)
cd <- read_csv("data/section_class_dates.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(section = as.character(section), code = trimws(code),
         class_date = mdy(date), due_date = mdy(due_reg_dt)) |>
  filter(section == selected_section)
needed_codes <- c("C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10", "C11")
stopifnot(all(needed_codes %in% cd$code), !anyDuplicated(cd$code))
fmt_date <- function(d) sub(" 0", " ", format(d, "%B %d, %Y"))
get_date <- function(code, meeting = FALSE) {
  row <- cd |> filter(.data$code == .env$code)
  if (meeting) return(fmt_date(row$class_date))
  time <- strptime(row$due_reg_tm, "%H:%M")
  paste(fmt_date(row$due_date), "at", sub("^0", "", format(time, "%I:%M %p")))
}
```

```{r section_label, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf("**ECO 230 Section %s: %s %s**\n\n", selected_section,
            section_info$semester_name, section_info$full_year))
cat(sprintf("Regular class meetings: %s, %s-%s, %s.\n\n",
            section_info$class_dow, section_info$class_start,
            section_info$class_end, section_info$classroom))
```

All times are Central Time. Due dates below use the same regular deadlines as Canvas.
For coaching and presentations, the meeting date is shown separately from the Canvas deadline.

```{r timeline}
timeline <- data.frame(
  Stage = c("Launch (Week 5)", "Analysis Plan", "Clean Dataset",
            "Pre-Coaching Presentation", "Coaching Session", "In-Person Presentation and Presentation Materials",
            "Technical Documentation"),
  `What the team should have ready` = c(
    "Choose statistical stories and begin planning.",
    "Hypotheses, variables, planned analyses, cleaning decisions, and teammate responsibilities.",
    "A shared dataset prepared in R, with documented cleaning and derived variables.",
    "A draft presentation with preliminary findings and questions for coaching.",
    "The draft presentation and specific questions about your analysis and story.",
    "A rehearsed business presentation and final slides. Have slides ready at least one hour before class.",
    "Annotated R scripts, R Markdown, or Quarto sources that reproduce the presented analysis."),
  `Due or meeting date` = c(
    get_date("C5", TRUE), get_date("C5"), get_date("C6"), get_date("C7"),
    paste("Class:", get_date("C9", TRUE), "| Canvas checkpoint:", get_date("C8")),
    paste("Class:", get_date("C11", TRUE), "| Canvas deadline:", get_date("C10")),
    get_date("C11")),
  Submission = c("Discuss in class; no separate submission.",
    "Submit in Prep Work: Analysis Plan in Canvas.",
    "Submit in Prep Work: Clean Data Set in Canvas.",
    "Upload in Prep Work: Pre-Coaching Presentation Draft in Canvas.",
    "Attend your coaching session; use the Canvas attendance checkpoint as directed.",
    "Present in class; upload final slides in Analysis Project - Slides in Canvas.",
    "Upload in Analysis Project - Code in Canvas."), check.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(timeline, format = "html")
```
